source: “0 A.D.” is set in [Exocet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exocet_%28typeface%29); “Wildfire Games” is in Akzidenz-Grotesk Extended BE. Neither of these fonts is available under a free license.

source: Please, use these logos only in order to link to the 0 A.D. or Wildfire Games websites or to describe 0 A.D. or Wildfire Games.
